bullets.text: Microsoft Flight Simulator's New Mission - Players can engage in aerial firefighting with a mission inspired by the **New South Wales Rural Fire Service**.
Azure Expands Across Europe - **Microsoft Azure** is enhancing its infrastructure to meet the growing demand for cloud and AI services.
AI-Driven Cybersecurity Enhancements - **Microsoft Defender** leverages AI to generate synthetic attack logs, improving threat detection capabilities.
New AI Security System Launched - **Microsoft**'s multi-model agentic security system achieved top scores in vulnerability detection benchmarks.
Xbox and Discord Collaboration - The partnership enhances **Game Pass** accessibility for players through **Discord Nitro**.
Free Microsoft Store Registration - Companies can now publish to the **Microsoft Store** with free registration and improved onboarding.
Advancing Passwordless Authentication - **Microsoft** promotes passkey adoption to enhance security and reduce reliance on passwords.
KuppingerCole Recognizes Microsoft - **Microsoft** named an overall leader in the 2026 Emerging AI Security Operations Center report.
